**Finding: missing — insurance provision absent (severity: low)**

The Agreement contains no insurance covenant anywhere: a full-text search for "insur" returns nothing, and Section 10 (General Provisions, p0059–p0070) runs Notices → No Joint Venture → Assignment → Waiver → Governing Law → Severability → Survival → Entire Agreement → Headings/Counterparts with no coverage requirement.

The rule is squarely engaged: HDI hosts the Site and, per Section 8.1, "may have access to or be exposed to, directly or indirectly, Content, user information, data" of the Company. A hosting vendor processing our customer and order data with zero insurance falls into the playbook's walk-away category, so an insert is warranted rather than a rationale note.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** new Section 10.9 inserted after p0070 at the preferred limits — CGL USD 1M per occurrence / 2M aggregate, E&O USD 2M, cyber/privacy USD 5M, statutory workers' compensation, coverage through the term plus one year, certificates on request. The comment offers the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M) as a landing zone if HDI pushes back on limits.
